properties.statement: Response strategy matches the interaction's dialogue act rather than defaulting to generic assistant exposition.
Context-dependent follow-ups preserve the relevant referent and choose a continuation strategy instead of restarting the conversation.
Response length/register strategy adapts to the user's conversational style when doing so does not change factual meaning.
A correction or challenge selects an acknowledgement/repair strategy before the corrected answer where appropriate.
Conversational strategies avoid repeated-question boilerplate and unsolicited closing offers and select bounded response-length bands.
Conversational style data contains no factual claims/evidence and cannot become an authority source for portfolio assertions.
